parole.testo: From an Iranian language, compare Zazaki des and Ossetian дӕс (dæs, “ten”), from Proto-Indo-European *déḱm̥. Komi дас (das) and Udmurt дас (das) are separate borrowings from an Iranian language.
From an Iranian language, compare Avestan 𐬬𐬁𐬭𐬀 (vāra, “entrenchment”), Middle Persian wl (war, “castle”), from *warš- (“height”) from Proto-Indo-European *wers- (“peak”).
